title: Quick Pancakes

steps.text: In a bowl, whisk the flour, baking powder and salt together.
Add the eggs and milk, then mix until you have a smooth batter with no lumps.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and melt a small knob of butter.
Pour a ladle of batter into the pan.
Cook until bubbles form on the surface and the edges look set, about 2 minutes.
Flip the pancake and cook for another minute until golden underneath.
Repeat with the remaining batter, adding a little butter to the pan as needed.
Serve the pancakes hot with maple syrup.

assumptions: Converted 2 cups of flour to 240 g of all-purpose flour.
Assumed 30 ml of milk for 'a splash'.
Assumed 2 teaspoons of baking powder, since no amount was given.
Assumed 1 pinch of salt as 1 pizca.
Assumed 20 g of butter for greasing the pan.
Assumed 60 ml of maple syrup for serving.
Estimated 4 servings, 5 minutes of prep and 15 minutes of cooking.
Added the step of whisking the dry ingredients first, and the step of melting the butter in the pan.
